ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Flying Sect
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
The flying sect for Convergence: Era of Cultivation, on top of the gravship system of Odyssey (same mechanic, our own pieces): a floating island you can move.
The Island Heart (a flight formation set in a beast core) is the engine; cloud rock is the ground of the island; flight cores set into gravity core mounts make it grow; qi thrusters and wind sails give it range; the essence vessel stores the spirit stones that fuel it; the helmsman's altar steers it, and the realm of the best cultivator adds range. No electricity, no chemfuel.
Requires Odyssey, Convergence: Era of Cultivation, Convergence: Resources and Convergence: Formations.
